purpose: Compact retained screen-placement reference for the first synchronized ordinary-2P racer replacement state.
interpretation: This is a regression reference, not a fixed runtime position. Replacement presentation must decode live low-OAM coordinates and apply the proven split-screen instance mapping; frame-end high OAM alone is not a complete placement model.

split_screen_instances.interpretation: Both semantic racers have one OAM instance per viewport. The top half exposes slots 98/99 and the bottom half exposes 97/96; low-OAM coordinates for both pairs coexist, while the active-display high-OAM write swaps which pair is visible.
